correctness.rationale: For A=gamma+2w>0 the central coherence of the spatially tilted infinite-chain Lindbladian has a simple isolated analytic eigenvalue at k=0. Schur complementation through four tilt powers visits only coherence separations ±1 and ±2; the resolvent terms give the stated exact K2 and K4. Writing z=(E/A)^2,s=w/A,y=(c/A)^2 yields K4/A=2s+B(z,s)y-C(z)y^2 with C=3(1+10z-3z^2)/((1+z)^3(1+4z)). C changes sign at z*=(5+2sqrt(7))/3. For z>=z*, B>0, K4>0; below, the concave quadratic has one positive root even when s=0. The equality z=z* and E=0 boundaries are included. Independent rational tilted-jet recursion at sample parameters returned K2=419/582 and K4=2426358037/1489482336, matching closed expressions; tests do not establish the infinite-chain spectrum by themselves.
